properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 16 at 7:49AM EDT by NWS Cleveland OH
properties.description:
At 749 AM EDT, Doppler radar was tracking strong thunderstorms along
a line extending from near Middlefield to near Hudson. Movement was
east at 70 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Warren, Streetsboro, Cortland, Middlefield, Garrettsville, Kinsman,
North Bloomfield, Orwell, Burton, Andover, Mantua, West Farmington,
Vienna Center, Bristolville, Leavittsburg, Aurora, Parkman, Vienna,
Mecca, and Windham.
properties.instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

properties.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 16 at 7:47AM EDT until October 16 at 11:00AM EDT by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
properties.description:
* WHAT...Up to one half foot of inundation above ground level in
low lying areas due to tidal flooding.

* WHERE...Shoreline in Anne Arundel County.

* WHEN...Until 11 AM EDT this morning, especially around the
time of high tide.

* IMPACTS...At 2.6 feet, water may begin to pond in the parking
lot at Annapolis City Dock, and surround the Alex Haley
Memorial.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Tides one and a half to two feet above
normal. The next high tide at Annapolis U.S. Naval Academy is at 8:55
AM and 10:39 PM.
properties.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

properties.areaDesc: Guam
properties.headline: Typhoon Warning issued October 16 at 9:43PM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
...TROPICAL STORM CHAMPI INTENSIFYING AND MOVING WEST TOWARDS THE
MARIANAS...
...CHAMPI LIKELY TO MOVE NEAR GUAM AS A TYPHOON...

.NEW INFORMATION...
Guam was placed in Condition of Readiness 2 as of 1 PM ChST.

.AREAS AFFECTED...
This local statement provides information and recommended actions for
people on Guam and on Rota, Tinian and Saipan in the Northern
Marianas.

.Watches/Warnings...
A Typhoon Warning continues for Guam and Rota.

A Tropical storm warning and a Typhoon Watch continue for Tinian
and Saipan.

A Flood Watch is in effect for all of Guam and the Northern
Marianas. Please listen closely for any Flood Warnings that might
be in effect for your area.

Please check the latest public and marine forecasts for detailed
information about additional hazards.

.STORM INFORMATION...
At 8 PM ChST...the center of Tropical Storm Champi (29W) was located
near latitude 11.6N...longitude 152.1E. This was about 510 miles
east-southeast of Guam. Storm motion was west, 275 degrees, at 13 mph.
Storm intensity was 60 mph.

.SITUATION OVERVIEW...
TS Champi continues to head toward Guam. Along the way, Rota will be
affected by lesser but still damaging winds toward the outside of
Champi. Tinian and Saipan will be just grazed by the edge.

.PRECAUTIONARY/PREPAREDNESS ACTIONS...
properties.instruction:
Make the final preparations to protect life and property. Rush
to completion the hardening of your home or business by closing
shutters and bracing garage doors.

If evacuating, leave as soon as possible. Guard against being
stuck out on roadways when dangerous winds and heavy rains
arrive. Again, do not stay in a metal roof or container home.
Remember, pets are not allowed in most official shelters, so
check ahead with your intended shelter.

If staying in a home, turn the refrigerator to maximum cold and
keep it closed. Turn off propane tanks and unplug small
appliances. Fill the bathtub with water in case the tap water
becomes unavailable after the storm. This is for cleaning and
flushing purposes. Do not drink it.
